result.topic_en: Rewriting the sine-series of the divisor sum Σ(−1)^{θ+1}/n^s via roots of unity ω = e^{2xπi} with x = h/m, and computing the divisor sum Σ(−1)^θ over divisors θ of n = 2^μ n' in terms of the number of divisors.
result.transcription:
[-$\Sigma\frac{}{n^s}$-] $\sin 2nx\pi = \frac{e^{2nx\pi i} - e^{-2nx\pi i}}{2i} = \frac{\omega^n - \omega^{-n}}{2i}$ ; $\omega = e^{2x\pi i}$ ; $\omega^m = 1$
$x = \frac{h}{m}$
$\sum \frac{\Sigma(-1)^{\theta+1}}{n^s\cdot\pi}\sin 2nx\pi = \frac{1}{2\pi i}\sum\frac{(\omega^n-\omega^{-n})\,\Sigma(-1)^{\theta+1}}{n^s}$
Sind $n'$, $n''$ relative Primzahlen, $n = n'n''$, so ist $\theta = \theta'\theta''$
[-$\Sigma(-1)^\theta = \Sigma(-1)^{\theta'\theta''}$-]
$n = 2^\mu n'$ ; $\theta = (1, 2, 2^2 \ldots 2^\mu)\,\theta'$ ; [-...-] $\alpha(n')$ Anzahl der Divisoren von $n'$
$\Sigma(-1)^\theta =$ [-...-] $-\alpha(n') + \mu\,\alpha(n') = (\mu-1)\,\alpha(n')$
$= \alpha(n) - 2\alpha(n')$
$\psi(n) = \Sigma(-1)^{\theta+1} = 2\alpha(n') - \alpha(n)$
$\psi(2n) \qquad = 2\alpha(n') - \alpha(2n)$
